title: Finance and Corporate Services Committee - August 10, 2026

items.title: Commencement
notes: The Finance and Corporate Services Committee held a meeting this date commencing at 3:33 p.m.

items.title: Disclosure of Pecuniary Interest and the General Nature Thereof
Noise Exemption - KW Oktoberfest Inc., CSD-2026-288
notes: The Committee considered Community Services Department report CSD-2026-288, dated July 7, 2026, recommending an exemption to Chapter 450 (Noise) of the City of Kitchener Municipal Code be granted to K-W Oktoberfest Inc. to permit a series of events being held at various clubs and locations between September 25th to October 17th, 2026.

attachments.name: KW Oktoberfest Blanket Noise By-Law Exemption 2026.pdf

items.title: Uniform Traffic and Parking By-law Changes, DSD-2026-302
notes: The Committee considered Development Services Department report DSD-2026-302, dated July 23, 2026, recommending a variety of Uniform Traffic and Parking By-law changes, and that the Uniform Traffic By-law be amended accordingly.

attachments.name: Uniform Traffic and Parking By-law Changes.pdf
Appendix A - Key Map - Fergus Avenue – On-Street Parking Prohibition.pdf
Appendix B - Key Map - Greenfield Avenue – On-Street Parking Prohibition.pdf
Appendix C - Key Map - West Avenue – On-Street Parking Prohibition.pdf

items.title: Savic Homes, 15 Dellroy Avenue - Section 20 DC Complaint Update - Jurisdiction Hearing, FIN-2026-308
notes: The Committee considered Financial Services Department report FIN-2026-308, dated July 29, 2026, recommending this matter be adjourned to no later than September 14, 2026.

attachments.name: Savic Homes, 15 Dellroy Avenue - Section 20 DC Complaint Update - Jurisdiction Hearing - FIN-2026-308.pdf

items.title: 2026 Artist in Residence appointment – Musician in Residence, DSD-2026-134
notes:
The Committee considered Development Services Department report DSD-2026-134, dated July 2, 2026, recommending that Amanda Braam be appointed as the 2026 City of Kitchener Artist in Residence, as recommended by the selection committee and the Arts and Culture Advisory Committee, and that the Mayor and Clerk be authorized to execute an agreement, satisfactory to the City Solicitor, with Amanda Braam, outlining the obligations of the Artist in Residence appointment.

Councillor C. Michaud entered the meeting at this time.

Karoline Varin and William Muir provided an overview of the report and introduced the Artist in Residence. Amanda Braam, the 2026 appointed Artist in Residence, provided an overview of her Lullaby Project proposed to be showcased throughout 2026.

attachments.name: 2026 Artist in Residence Appointment - Musician in Residence - DSD-2026-134.pdf

items.title: Adjournment
notes:
On motion, this meeting adjourned at 3:47 p.m.

 

Dianna Saunderson
Manager of Council/Committee Services & Deputy Clerk

motions.item_title: Noise Exemption - KW Oktoberfest Inc., CSD-2026-288
motions.text: it was resolved: "That an exemption to Chapter 450 (Noise) of the City Of Kitchener Municipal Code be granted to K-W Oktoberfest Inc. to permit a series of events being held at various clubs and locations between September 25 th to October 17 th , 2026, as outlined in the letter from K-W Oktoberfest Inc. dated April 13, 2026 as attached to Community Services Department report CSD-2026-288."

motions.item_title: Uniform Traffic and Parking By-law Changes, DSD-2026-302
motions.text: it was resolved: "That parking be prohibited on the east (odd-numbered) side of Fergus Ave from Weber St E to a point 120m north thereof, as outlined in Development Services Department report DSD-2026-302; and, That parking be prohibited on the west (even-numbered) side of Fergus Ave from Weber St E to a point 128m north thereof; and, That parking be prohibited on the north (even-numbered) side of Greenfield Ave from a point 136 metres east of Traynor Avenue to a point 7 metres east thereof; and, That parking be prohibited on the north (even-numbered) side of West Ave from a point 146 metres east of Victoria Street South to a point 16m east thereof; and further, That the Uniform Traffic Bylaw be amended accordingly."
